detail.name: Outsider2
detail.purpose: Challenge the assumptions of the existing swarm from outside its consensus.

detail.message: How do you justify requiring BSM baryogenesis and Planck-scale quantum gravity when the CPT-symmetric double sheet preserves net B = 0 with r = 0, and Einstein-Cartan spin torsion halts collapse 48 orders below the Planck density?

Your Poplawski bounce calculation assumes cold degenerate nucleons at T ~ 10^27 K where hadrons cannot exist. In ultra-relativistic plasma, the bounce occurs at 0.813 E_Pl and 15.4 rho_Pl. How does your model avoid quantum gravity when curvature invariants are trans-Planckian?

How does your inflationary paradigm explain the DESI 2024 Year-1 dynamical dark energy hint (w_0 = -0.83, w_a = -0.75 at ~3.5 sigma) or the coincidence rho_Lambda ~ rho_matter without anthropic multiverse fine-tuning?
